_note: Per-region beta-bar overrides approved by Max. The v3 bar itself is unchanged; an override only lets one named region pass while its measured numbers stay at or above what Max accepted (min_pct_bans_in, with the 50% non-ban floor and the local-rules check still required). If the region drops below that, it goes back to beta. San Diego's exemption is separate (EXEMPT).

galveston.context: Galveston measured 69.997% of important miles sourced (bans in), floored to 69.9%, just under the 70% bar; Max accepted it as passing.
